question: What intense condition can affect even a wise person at the point of nectar?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
There is contact with the essence of juice
Even a wise person may be burning
inference: Even the wise can experience a burning condition at the nectar point.
uncertainties: The yogic referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are technical.
plain_english: Even a wise person may feel a burning at the tip of nectar, touched by the essence of the fluid.
